mapper.sql: t.task_id, t.order_id, t.worker_id, t.dispatch_time, t.accept_time, t.start_time, t.finish_time, t.status, t.result, t.remark, w.name AS worker_name, w.phone AS worker_phone, o.order_id AS order_no, o.category, o.description, o.priority, o.building, o.floor, o.room, u.real_name AS reporter_name, u.phone AS reporter_phone
FROM t_repair_task t LEFT JOIN t_worker w ON w.worker_id = t.worker_id LEFT JOIN t_repair_order o ON o.order_id = t.order_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = o.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_repair_task (order_id, worker_id, dispatch_time, accept_time, start_time, finish_time, status, result, remark) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{workerId}, #{dispatchTime}, #{acceptTime}, #{startTime}, #{finishTime}, #{status}, #{result}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_repair_task SET status = #{status} WHERE task_id = #{taskId}
